Results.ReviewText: Been grilling on gas all my life. Got a smoker a while ago and it got me interested in wooden fuel. Got this as a birthday gift and love it. It's making the best burgers and chicken I've had in a while.
Results.Title: First charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill three years ago, so I now feel qualified to review it. In a word, awesome. The build quality is excellent, it's easy to use and move around, and even after three years of sitting out in the elements (covered, of course) it shows no signs of wear and tear other than a bit of normal rust on the grilling surface. You can't beat the flavor of cooking with charcoal, and Weber does it best!
Results.Title: Outstanding grill

Results.Title: Horrible Experience

We recommend using a mitt or glove for protection. Your grill is backed by an amazing warranty. If you experience any issues, please contact us directly. We are here to help. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: The ash removal process requires superhuman strength in the hands..........

I have a two burner Weber and wanted something a little more flavor inducing - bought the kettle and am extremely happy - this is my third 22" kettle in 40 years and now I have gas and charcoal Webers at two homes and left the third for the buyer of my first condo
Results.Title: Always reliable

Results.ReviewText: This kettle does everything I need it to do from slow cooking to fast searing. It also has my wife and I spending more time outside enjoying each other, nature, and the wonderful smells and food that are made from this kettle!
Results.Title: The Kettle That Can

Results.ReviewText: This is my third kettle and its not as well built as the previous two. Lid bounces off when moving it, and just seems thinner metal
Results.Title: Latest Weber not as good as original

Results.ReviewText: I have Weber gas grills for the past 15 years and they have been great! I still have my latest Genesis E-315 and use it several times a week. However, I missed the old charcoal and wood smoke flavor of my large smoker pits that are just too big for the 2 of us. I recently purchased the Weber 22" kettle as I remember the quality and toughness of my previous kettles. We really enjoy smoking pork, beef, poultry, and seafood (since we live along the coast).  Smoking gives a whole new dimension of flavor to seafood! Glad we purchased the kettle so we can go "old school" again.
Results.Title: Return to Old School

Results.ReviewText: Lump charcoal is way better than propane!!! Weber kettle grill makes grill'in and chill'in way better!
Results.Title: King of the hill has it wrong

Results.ReviewText: I'm really enjoying my new 22" kettle premium. This is my first charcoal grill and it's been fun learning how to get the results I want. I especially like the large ash catcher.
Results.Title: Fun New Grill

Results.ReviewText: Bought this for a big bar b que at my house.  I cooked racks of ribs and my grandson cooked 2 spatchcocked turkeys (one at a time) on his new grill!
Results.Title: For my grandson

Results.ReviewText: Had to give up my first Weber grill due to a move a decade ago. Moved again and got the improved version with the ash catcher and other accessories. Grill love even better second time around.
Results.Title: The grill I always wanted, and have again

Results.ReviewText: I always cooked on weber gas grills in the past and aside from the bi-annual grate and flavor bar replacements I loved grilling on them. Recently and after a cross country move I opted for a charcoal kettle grill. So far, no problems with the grill but there is/will be a learning curve. I am not sure if I would attempt to roast a turkey or prime rib roast on the charcoal grill like I did several times a year on my gas grills. Adding fresh charcoal and the nasty smoke smell does not seem like a good idea.
Results.Title: New to charcoal

Results.ReviewText: Best All Around Grill for Beginners and the Experienced alike.
Results.Title: Best Grill Around for a reason

Results.ReviewText: Awful quality and customer service. I purchased a stealth premium kettle from Lowe’s and the grill has had so many quality controls issues. The legs and dampers had chipped paint and grill grate would not sit flat, it would wobble no matter what orientation it was in on the grill. To address the grate issue I was first sent a new grate, that didn’t fix the problem. I was first told the chipped paint didn’t affect performance so they treated that like a non issue until a customer service “specialist “  started to reply to the emails. He got replacement parts sent out for the parts with chipped paint then also told me the prongs that hold the grill grate were misaligned and I was being sent a new bowl as well. The replacement bowl shows up with paint damage so I emailed Weber back about that issue then they ghosted me. Never responded back. I had to find their number on the better business bureau website to escalate the issue. Beware of the awful quality control on their products and their horrible customer that just stops responding. Very unprofessional from someone who was a “specialist” lmao. I will not be purchasing any Weber products in the future. Which is a shame because their summit Kamado looked sweet but no way I’m dropping that kind of money when their quality is very inconsistent and poor customer service to support you when you have issues.
Results.Title: Cheap product, awful customer service.

Results.ReviewText: There is no other grill that is even close. My newest one brings me up to 4 that I own in total.
Results.Title: The best Grills

Results.ReviewText: I express myself through my Weber kettle. I know how silly that must sound. We began as a species in search of fire - Weber provides a stage to control that fire to cook with.
Results.Title: The Weber Way

Results.ReviewText: This grill has enough room to make a large paella. It heats quickly and evenly.
Results.Title: Grilled to perfection

Results.ReviewText: I am a first-time griller and started out with grilling vegetables and they turned out fantastic!   Next was smoked/grilled chicken wings and they were great also.  I love the temperature gauge on the lid, it helps a lot when I need to know when the grill is ready to cook on.  Looking forward to many hours of grilling this year!!!
Results.Title: Ease of using the grill

Results.ReviewText: As usual this is a great grill. Love the kettle shape
Results.Title: Kenny Kettle

Results.ReviewText: My first Weber. I love it but find the temp gauge not really useful in its location. One below the baffle on the lid would be much more strategically placed.
Results.Title: 1st Weber.

Results.ReviewText: The grill was great. It is helpful to read manual.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Plenty of grill space for both direct and indirect grilling. Nice fittings and such. Ash dump system is nifty, but because the leg connection to the grill housing is a tad on the loose side, the whole grill wobbles a fair bit when dumping the ashes.
Results.Title: Darned fine grill, if a touch wobbly.

Results.ReviewText: Outstanding grill, I've been grilling with this style of grill for ever. Love it.
Results.Title: Weber 22" grill

Results.ReviewText: I had the same model for 15 years until the leg mounts to the base rusted off and it collapsed.  There are few improvements to the old design, with the heat shield at the handle and slightly improve ash removal arrangement being the most notable.  That said, I'll bet ours was not the first to have the legs fall off. (Which is surprising given it was under several official Weber covers it's entire existence.). So, while 15 years is pretty good, I think it could be better.
Results.Title: It's the Same as My Old One

Results.ReviewText: Great unit. Only problem in time is that the bottom part that holds the ash tends to fall off
Results.Title: Great grill, just a small issue

Results.ReviewText: Does the best of any other charcoal grill I’ve used
Results.Title: Grill

Results.ReviewText: Solid grill. I have grilled a whole rack on this thing with no issues
Results.Title: Good stuff

Results.ReviewText: This grill is the sweet spot of cost effective outdoor grilling. I got mine assembled at Lowe's.
Results.Title: Excellent perfect choice

Results.ReviewText: Excellent Value! Built to last and superb cooking control.
Results.Title: Excellent Value!

Results.ReviewText: The ash clean out is a poor design, leaves alot of ash in bowl needs to go hole to hole
Results.Title: Ash clean out

Results.ReviewText: This grill is. Game changer! The premium 22 in. Grill is the one to get. It is a great cooking experience every time. The taste the flavor is excellent! I also use every feature this grill has to offer! It's every thing you need nothing you don't. The ash management system is excellent. The add charcoal feature is great. The grate hangs on the grill along with the lid. I am very happy I decided to purchase the 22 in premium kettle charcoal grill!!
Results.Title: A must have grill!!

Results.ReviewText: .   So easy and accurate to maintain temperature points throughout the grilling cycle.  Easy ash disposal — the easiest of all charcoal grills.
Results.Title: The King of grilling

Results.ReviewText: Ash catcher broke after couple months. Weber sent new part free of charge under warranty. That's why 4 of 5 *'s. As far as the grill goes, very happy with it.
Results.Title: 4 out of 5 aint bad!!

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
